item.title: Anna (Nancy) McCabe
item.description: Anna (Nancy) McCabe Kilmore, Ballyjamesduff, Co. Cavan, and recently 17 Glenview, Ballyjamesduff Anna (Nancy) McCabe passed away on Sunday 18th January 2026. Nancy died peacefully, surrounded by her loving family in the compassionate care of the doctors, nurses and staff of Cavan General Hospital. Predeceased by her parents John and Mary, and her sister Cathy. Sadly missed by her loving family Patsy, John, Mary, Rosaleen, Marie and Paddy, nieces, nephews, extended family, neighbours and friends.

item.title: Bailieboro native to complete 1000m swim every day over January
item.description: A Bailieboro native is completing a 1000m swim each day over the month of January. It's all in aid of the Cavan Hospital Special Care Baby Unit and to raise awarness of the service in the area. Aaron Hynes has been completing a January challenge for the past 8 years now since his little boy Harry was born 10 weeks prematurely. item.title: Live Updates: St. Brigid's v Dingle
item.description: Follow live updates of the All-Ireland club football final as St. Brigid's face Dingle in Croke Park. St. Brigid's edged out Scotstown in the semi-final. Whereas, Dingle stunned favourites Ballyboden St. Enda's in their semi-final with a two-point win. Roscommon and Connacht champions Brigid's make their fourth All-Ireland final appereance having won in 2013. Whereas, Dingle are making their first apperance at this stage. Advertisement Throw-in is 3:40pm.

item.title: Kellie Harrington wins national championship
item.description: Double Olympic champion Kellie Harrington claimed her 12th Elite title at the national championships. All five judges gave Harrington the nod over reigning Elite champ, Kellie McLoughlin of St. Catherine's BC Dublin. Whereas, Double Olympian Michaela Walsh has now won an incredible 14 Elite titles, more than any other Boxing Ireland athlete in history. item.title: Co. Monaghan electorate drops in 2025
item.description: The overall electorate in Co. Monaghan dropped by 1,303 people between 2024 and November 2025. That's according to figures released by Monaghan County Council. In June of last year, the council undertook a "data cleanse" of the Register of Electors. Advertisement This involved sending letters to nearly 7,000 electors missing a date of birth or Eircode. item.title: Planning for Battery Energy Storage System in Cavan
item.description: Planning permission has been granted for the development of a Battery Energy Storage System in Co. Cavan. Cavan County made the decision on the development at Drumman and Errigal in Cootehill last week. The development is for 10-year planning permission for the provision of a Battery Energy Storage System and compound on a site of c. 1.27ha to support the adjacent permitted solar farm. item.description: A collective of Irish based human rights groups is advocating for a fundamental shift in the way we deal with the international protection process.
